name: Aster X1 Visual Layout Harness
intent: Make the protected Agent output visually distinct from a generic landing page, especially on mobile.

hero.desktopGrid: 7/5 split with device stage on the right

avoid: generic three-card feature section as the main proof
multiple filled primary CTAs in one viewport

mobileChecks: No text overlaps the product mockup at 375px width.
Sticky preorder bar stays visible without covering section headings.
Hero headline, deposit, countdown, and CTA fit in the first mobile viewport.
Model cards become a horizontal snap rail or single-column cards.
All tap targets are at least 44px tall.
